name: Ogun Data Engineering & Lineage Agent
description: Local-first data engineering platform agent for lineage tracking, reproducible pipeline orchestration, and sandboxed operator benchmarking.

skills.name: Validate Workflow
skills.description: Validate workflow JSON documents against canonical schemas and compute deterministic execution plans.
examples: Validate workflow definition for bikeshare ingestion

skills.name: Inspect Lineage Graph
skills.description: Query OpenLineage DAGs, content-addressed artifact hashes, and dataset provenance records.

skills.name: Execute Operator Benchmark
skills.description: Execute data processing operators inside a Windows AppContainer or Linux sandbox with pinned code hashes.
examples: Run benchmark on dedupe operator in AppContainer

skills.name: Trigger Backfill Partitions
skills.description: Orchestrate and resume partition backfills after crash or kill -9, processing only unfinished work.
